entries.25b4623c945068b1: Businesses in the retail and distribution industries
entries.33a938379df8bda7: A restaurant company that operates the tiger pufferfish (torafugu) specialty restaurant "Genpin" through directly managed stores and franchises, and also engages in mail-order sales and food ingredient sales.
entries.704f93c470b3156e: This is the only business of the company's group (a single segment), operating the specialty Torafugu restaurant 'Genpin' through company-owned stores and franchises. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,272 million. As of March 31, 2026, there were 41 company-owned stores and 20 franchise stores in Japan, and there are also stores in Singapore. Its headquarters in Matsubara, Osaka Prefecture has the West Japan Logistics Center, equipped with a central kitchen, which processes ingredients and supplies them to stores. The consolidated subsidiaries are two companies: Kanmonkai (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., which handles ingredient procurement and other operations in China, and KANMONKAI-SG PTE. LTD., which operates 'Genpin' in Singapore.
entries.7098b31787e9fff5: This is the main format. It mainly uses Torafugu raised with aquaculture operators using patented technology such as long-term low-temperature aging. It also serves eel dishes and hamo dishes. The sales results as printed show 'Torafugu dishes' at ¥4,105 million.
entries.765a67bcf860f401: In addition to mail-order sales delivering Torafugu to homes, there are ingredient sales to retail and distribution businesses and other sectors, as well as ingredient sales to franchisees and royalties.
